test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can do a piece of work alone in 32 days, while together with B she can do the work in 24 days. If C alone can do the work in 64 days, in how many days can B and C together do the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work alone in 32 days

Together with B, she can do the work in 24 days

C alone can do the work in 64 days

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = (Work space done)/(Numberspace ofspace days)

**Calculation:**

A can the work = 32 days

⇒ A does work in 1 day = (1)/(32)

Similarly,

Together with B, she does the work = 24 days

⇒ A + B = 24

Amount of (A + B) together work in one day

⇒ (1)/(32)+(1)/(B)=(1)/(24)

⇒ (1)/(B)=(1)/(24)-(1)/(32)=(4-3)/(96)=(1)/(96)

C can do the work = 64 days

⇒ C does work in 1 day = (1)/(64)

B and C together can work in one day

⇒ (1)/(96)+(1)/(64)=(2+3)/(192)=(5)/(192)

⇒ B and C together complete the work in = (192)/(5) = 38(2)/(5)

**Hence, B and C together can complete the work in **38(2)/(5)
